# Stale Note

This concept page documents a piece of behavior that was accurate as of its
`stale_after` date but has likely drifted since then. It exists to exercise the
`stale_after` frontmatter field in the parser's field mapping. The body carries
ordinary prose so the chunking and quality gates have real sentences to work
with.
